response.overview: Three years after the apocalypse, Germany has fallen under the control of a ruthless new regime. In a world overrun by the dead and ruled by the merciless, Antonio, a broken survivor haunted by loss and betrayal, struggles to find a reason to keep going. But as the ghosts of his past refuse to fade, he discovers that the greatest threat isn't the dead wandering the earth — it's the people who are still alive.
response.tagline: EVERY SECOND COUNTS - EVERY CHOICE HAS A PRICE
response.title: No Way Back
